title: Honeyed Ukrainian Cranberry Bread
description: Earthy, crisp Ukrainian bread featuring cranberries and a hint of honey, perfect for a kid-friendly breakfast or snack.
instructions: Prepare a 9x5-inch loaf pan by greasing it with butter or cooking spray.
Combine 1 cup of warm water and 2 teaspoons of sugar-free honey in a large mixing bowl.
Add 2 teaspoons of active dry yeast and let it sit for 5 minutes, or until frothy.
Add 3 cups of all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon of salt, and 1 teaspoon of black pepper to the bowl.
Mix in 1 cup of fresh or frozen cranberries and 1/2 cup of chopped walnuts.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in the prepared loaf pan and cover it with a damp cloth.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Bake the bread for 35-40 minutes, or until it is golden brown and sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom.
Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for 10-15 minutes before slicing.
If desired, serve with a dollop of whipped cream or a sprinkle of honey.
To store, wrap the bread tightly in plastic wrap and keep it at room temperature for up to 3 days.
To freeze, wrap the bread tightly in plastic wrap and place it in a freezer-safe bag for up to 2 months.
